payload.name: Compress Image to KB by PrintableTools Lab
payload.short_description: Free no-signup image-to-KB compressor with an optional one-contact USD 9 upload fix-plan request.
payload.long_description: A free browser-based image-to-KB compressor for people whose forms, portals, profiles, or applications reject photos over a target size. It works without an account or server upload and now exposes a one-contact optional USD 9 Upload Limit Fix Plan request for exact settings, fallback steps, and a review-before-upload checklist after fit is confirmed.
